goal: Prevent node crashes and integer overflows when funding transactions with recipient amounts over MAX_MONEY
Stop RPC calls from incorrectly funding outputs that exceed the 21 million bitcoin limit
agreement: Solid support with no blocking technical objections
Verified by testing on macOS that edge cases no longer abort the node (Zippo76)
Support as a worthwhile sanity check that aids sanitizers and fuzzing (maflcko)
Approval with an open nano-nit on checking the running recipient sum directly (furszy)
Process concerns raised about AI assistance and submitting multiple PRs at once (pinheadmz, sedited)

categories.name: wallet
why: P3 because it fixes an assertion crash and undefined behavior, but only on nonsensical inputs
Addresses an edge-case reliability issue in wallet funding that is reasonably deferrable
